description: This Java class `ShippingPackagingController` is a Spring MVC web controller responsible for handling HTTP requests related to shipping packaging settings in an admin interface. It provides methods to display the shipping packaging configuration page and to save changes to the configuration.

classes.name: ShippingPackagingController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing shipping packaging configuration in the admin interface, including displaying and saving configuration settings.

methods.name: displayShippingPackaging
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the shipping packaging configuration page, retrieving current configuration or initializing a default one.

methods.name: saveShippingPackaging
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save the updated shipping packaging configuration, processing form data and persisting changes.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu context data for the admin interface, setting active menu items and current menu.
